description: This Java source file defines the class 'ConfigurableStatusAndHealthProvider', which implements 'StatusAndHealthProvider'. The class provides configurable methods to retrieve system status and health information using supplied 'StatusSupplier' and 'StatusHealthSupplier' instances. It includes a static factory method to create instances with given suppliers.
